description: Shakarganj Limited is a diversified industrial company incorporated in 1967 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, built around sugar and its by-products. It produces high-grade refined sugar for food and pharmaceutical customers, including multinational beverage brands, and sells white crystalline sugar and crystal and soft brown sugar in retail packs. Through its biofuels division it runs an anhydrous ethanol distillery producing fuel-grade bio-ethanol and exports renewable power.
